responsibility: This file is the DFA-based scheduling model for the MIPS32 4K family, especially 4kc and 4kp variants. It defines the integer and multiply/divide resources and reservation patterns for loads, stores, branches, ALU operations, HI/LO moves, and the distinct pipelined versus iterative multiply/divide behaviors of the 4K cores, letting GCC schedule code according to the family’s simple integer pipeline and highly variant MDU characteristics.
